name: Calliope
source:
Tarot: The Magician
Music Genre: Visual kei, idol pop, noise
Likes: Cute girls, mentally ill girls, spoiling people, dark humor
Dislikes: Death, people who are too serious, being abandoned

Calliope is the lead programmer for Emma and is likely credited
for a lot of advanced robot programs on her planet. She feels bad 
taking credit for this as she was inspired by work of past programmers.

She's a very sweet person, but she also says a lot of bizarre things
that make people uncomfortable. Calliope can be rather flippant 
and doesn't have a strong moral compass. 

In college, she ran around with a lot of other lolita trans girls. 
She dragged Adelaide into her friend group. She misses Adelaide a lot, 
along with everyone from back then.

[From in-game profile]
